notes.title: October Progress Report
notes.content:
This is a report on the progress made in October, and although not much I have great reason to why.

So, first off, let me show off this new map. There are features for each room in the top right that I don't feel are good enough to show you yet, but I'm sure next month ill have it ready.
MANY more gameplay aspects are planned, including the ability to.... MOVE. This game is gonna get a LOT harder let me say that now.

Below are some block-outs of this new map, this is the final block-out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43481719/07c1ad725ad724b9e45abdcf2c3c52db35ec51c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43481719/0e64bcb03456c310d1581b4b429495d9baeb56a0.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43481719/c6350e3314669e81a8a683669124b60509d22f6c.png[/img]


So why has there not been any more progress?! Well its because I'm doing business with a man who goes online as AshDubh. Some of you may know him from stampylongnose, or iballisticsquid.
Point is I've been busy with that and working with him on his upcoming Minecraft SMP, in which I am hosting. Along with future servers he plans to have.

Its also good to let you all know in November & December don't expect much either, as I myself am actually in the said SMP, and would like to keep up to date with it. This does not mean there wont be any progress, it just means its not going to be like "oh here's a prototype" by then end of November. chances are the EARLY prototype will be out late January 2024 with a full release somewhere from May-July.

Other than that o hope you all have an amazing day, and HAPPY HALLOWEEN!

- Aiden, Lead Developer

notes.title: 2.6.1 | New Graphics GUI + NEWS
notes.content:
The update for 2.6.1 has been released. Graphics options can now be separately changed in the main menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43481719/051c0f3d9dbd9f6c2bc1aa4b62aab7b56ff1c474.png[/img]

[h1]Why Did this Take So Long?[/h1]
Let me explain why this took so long,
Saving.

Thats why.

The game has something internally called Saveables. I created Saveables.
Basically they are an easy way to write data to the save file. 
Unfortunately for me I dont know how it works anymore, and i have no clue what does what
Because my genius thought it would be fun to not describe anything within the Core. Which is where Saveables are programmed. The core is a 4000+ line script that is essentially the core of the game. 

I forgot how many things in the game work due to rushed variable names and no comments.\
So saving no longer works. I destroyed it (it may still somewhat work sometimes)

Most of you who have played this game before will now see a "Saving Failures" button in the main menu.
This button will show data in the save file that wasn't loaded. Basically old Saveables that no longer exists in-game (removed feature, etc)

[h1]Whats Next Then?[/h1]

[h3]A whole re-write of all the games scripts.[/h3]
This isn't easy, but with the new game mechanic you all voted on its best if i just re do the programming in the game. It allows me to fix all the bugs and make everything actually readable.

No other changes then a complete re-programming of all the scripts. 
Ill keep you all updated with how this goes in the discord server (https://discord.gg/kqqHPPm2ZY) & here.

Hope you enjoy the update, sorry it took so long.

Aiden

notes.title: V2.5.0 - Patches & Changes
notes.content:
[b]V2.5.0[/b]

[i][b]Updates brought to you by Binary. AKA Aiden.
Spent all of today on this so hope it betters the smogs expereince![/b][/i]

[u][i][h1]MAJOR BUG FIXES:[/h1][/i][/u]
[h3]Fixed Windows 11 crashes, or so I hope. still waiting for QA to test, but its fixed it for me.
Let me know if you still have crashes on Windows 11![/h3]

[i][b]EDIT:[/b][/i]
[u][i][h1]MAJOR FOUND BUGS:[/h1][/i][/u]
[b][i][u]Currently a bug has been found.
Sometimes the Credits scene decides its not its day to load, when it does this you must ALT + F4 the game.
I am working on a new patch tomorrow that will hopefully cover this just found bug and some others.[/u][/i][/b]

[h2][u][b]BUG FIXES:[/b][/u][/h2]
[b][olist]
[*] V-Sync no longer speeds up the main menu camera rotation
[*] Main menu camera no longer moves slightly up on Y-axis with rotation.
[*] Cinematic Mode now has working exit binds
[*] Cinematic Mode no longer throws internal errors on load
[*] Loading percentage has now been fixed (Math for this previously was wrong)
[*] Camera no longer moves while you are in the exit menu. (please note the exit menu does not pause the game!)
[*] Fixed the phone animations not being aligned with delta time
[*] Fixed the movement not being aligned with delta time
[*] Fixed the Save Button in the load save menu from overlapping the options menu.
[*] Fixed loading a save crashing the game
[*] Fixed AutoLoad not auto loading saves
[/olist][/b]

[h2][u][b]Added:[/b][/u][/h2]
[olist]
[h2][*] Audio sliders to both the main menu, and in-game menu.[/h2]
[h3][b]Audio only saves changes from the main menu, not within the game. although it can be changed from in-game. (this is why i need to re-write the saving API)[/b][/h3]
[*] Added a version indicator to the main menu
[/olist]

[h2][i][b]Changes:[/b][/i][/h2]
[b][olist]
[*] Edited the legal text on Main Menu to not take up 80% of the bottom
[*] Edited the Game Exit Menu options, subtitles are now named Closed Captions, following work on captions for the game.
(a lot of people don't know this, but you can access closed captions from within the games exit menu!)
[*] Edited Discord rich presence from "Content Creator Build" (old) to "Early Access" (new)
[*] Changed Steam rich presence (see below)
 - Arrived At Smogs = Main Menu
 - Starting The Night Shift = Phoneguy, or pre-phoneguy
 - On The Night Shift {night_time}AM = past phone call, night started
[/olist][/b]

[b]NOTICE:[/b]
[b][i]The Saving scripts will eventually be completely re-written, just a heads up! this will cause data too go boom, unless i make an old data converter, which i might.
This all is well into the future however.[/i][/b]


[b][i]Removed:[/i]
[olist]
[*] Funny Modes have been removed for complicating internal scripting (may add them back in the future)
[/olist][/b]

notes.title: An Update From The Developers
notes.content:
[u][b]Good morning/afternoon everyone![/b][/u]

id like to quickly announce that we have changed the game name to
[i][b]Five Nights At Smog's[/b][/i]
We felt it fit the game better.
But fear not, the game is still within the Smog's Poutinerie Franchise!

Continuation,
We at ForReal game studios have been hard at work developing FNASP.

We wanted to update all of our 300+ wish listers (thank you!) that the game is on track to be released in Early Access in Q2, around the end of April going into March. Our planned, but not set Early Access release, is April 27th. There is no promises that we can make this date. 

We as a team at FRGames are working everyday making sure you guys get what you came for.

Thanks to everyone for wish listing this game, it means a lot to us, to go from a school project, to forming a studio, to then releasing a game on steam. all with what was in a month. 


We want to make sure you guys get what you wish listed for, but we just need time, as hard working students, we don't get a lot of it.

But be not afraid, as this game is still, everyday, being worked on behind the scenes.
from voicings, to music, to game mechanics.

And we now have plans to add Subtitles to the game, and closed captions.
We feel all games should have this, and we aren't going to forget about them.

Oh, and huge shout out to Aldo Tinoc for the new Smog's Art!

[i][b]- The FRGames Team[/b][/i]
